hubs.title: Sleep
hubs.question: How can I build a more reliable sleep routine without turning weak evidence into a prescription?
hubs.summary: Build routines around sleep timing, recovery, and environment while keeping observational findings separate from causal claims.

hubs.title: Focus
hubs.question: How can I start important work and stay with it instead of constantly switching?
hubs.summary: Reduce switching, lower task-start friction, and protect attention with bounded work structures and explicit priorities.

hubs.title: Memory
hubs.question: How can I remember what I learn without confusing retention with application?
hubs.summary: Improve retention with retrieval, interference management, and conservative post-learning practices while separating memory from skill transfer.

hubs.title: Stress
hubs.question: What low-risk practices can help me respond to stress without treating a knowledge library like clinical care?
hubs.summary: Use bounded regulation, controllability, and self-awareness practices while keeping treatment claims outside Brali's practical layer.

hubs.title: Habits
hubs.question: How can I make a useful behavior easier to repeat consistently?
hubs.summary: Lower friction, use reliable cues, and review what actually happened instead of relying on motivation as a permanent fuel source.

hubs.title: Learning
hubs.question: How can I learn through retrieval, practice, feedback, and application rather than passive exposure?
hubs.summary: Combine retrieval, feedback, and application practice while distinguishing remembering information from being able to use it.

hubs.title: Movement & Exercise
hubs.question: How can I move more and build sustainable physical routines without inventing a magic cognitive break dose?
hubs.summary: Break up sedentary time and support sustainable movement, mobility, and strength while keeping exploratory cognition findings in bounds.
